newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka buys 12,500 tonnes sugar at $338.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys 12,500 tonnes sugar at $338.

text.p: Sri Lanka has bought 12,500 tonnes of white sugar from South Korea's Sam Yong Company Ltd for arrival in Colombo during the second half of February, government officials said on Thursday.
The price of the cargo is $338 per tonne C & F, an official for the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said.
Sri Lanka called for tenders for the same quantity of sugar last June, but did not buy as offers were in the $380-390 level, which was too high, CWE officials earlier said.
